method.app_order: Descending source count; ties by ascending app_name.
method.candidate_rule: Use the same strictly increasing triple in every band.
method.validity: Require three distinct in-range positions in every band.
method.distance: Occurrence-weighted source_subtype TVD; absent subtype counts are zero.
method.distance_comparison: Exact rational arithmetic, with no floating-point tolerance.
method.tvd_ties: Report all exact minima; select the lexicographically smallest percentage triple.
method.rank_ties: Equal exact TVD values share the rank 1 + number of strictly smaller values.
method.execution_order: Retain the original Main49 case order after selecting app membership.
